<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>Implement a simplified radix-2 divider on 8-bit signed or unsigned integers. The module accepts a dividend and a divisor as inputs and provides a 16-bit result containing both the quotient and the remainder. The design supports both signed and unsigned division operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE_START">1'b1</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE_END">1'b0</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter to keep track of the number of iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt">Flag to indicate the start of the division process.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg">Register to hold the result validity status.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">Register to store the negative value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="dividend_abs" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the absolute value of the dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_abs" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the absolute value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="result_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the final result.</reg>
        <reg id="SR" width_description="[9:0]">Shift Register to store the current remainder and quotient.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            // Combinational logic for result calculation
            case ({cnt[3], 1'b0})
                {1'b1}: begin
                    // Perform subtraction and handle carry-out
                    {SR[9], SR} = {1'b0, SR[9:0]} + neg_divisor;
                    // Mux to select between subtraction result and previous value
                    SR[9:0] = (SR[9]) ? {1'b0, SR[9:0]} : {1'b1, SR[9:0]};
                end
                default: begin
                    // No subtraction needed
                    SR[9:0] = {1'b0, SR[9:0]};
                end
            endcase
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk or active low reset
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
            // Reset condition
            if (!rst) begin
                // Initialize registers and flags
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                start_cnt <= DIVIDE_START;
                res_valid_reg <= DIVIDE_END;
                neg_divisor <= 9'd0;
                dividend_abs <= 8'd0;
                divisor_abs <= 8'd0;
                result_reg <= 16'd0;
                SR <= 10'd0;
            end else begin
                // Check if there's a valid operation request
                if (opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                    // Save inputs
                    dividend_abs <= dividend;
                    divisor_abs <= divisor;
                    
                    // Calculate negative divisor
                    neg_divisor <= ~{1'b0, divisor_abs} + 9'd1;
                    
                    // Initialize shift register
                    SR <= {1'b0, dividend_abs << 1};
                    
                    // Set counter and start flag
                    cnt <= 4'd1;
                    start_cnt <= DIVIDE_START;
                end
                
                // Division process
                if (start_cnt) begin
                    // Check if counter has reached maximum iteration
                    if (cnt[3]) begin
                        // End of division process
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                        start_cnt <= DIVIDE_END;
                        
                        // Update result register
                        result_reg <= {SR[9:0], 1'b0}; // Adjust for correct placement of remainder and quotient
                    end else begin
                        // Increment counter
                        cnt <= cnt + 4'd1;
                        
                        // Update shift register
                        SR <= {SR[8:0], SR[9]};
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Output assignment
        assign res_valid = res_valid_reg;
        assign result = result_reg;
        
        // Logic to manage res_valid signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
            if (!rst) begin
                res_valid_reg <= DIVIDE_END;
            end else begin
                if (cnt == 4'd8) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b1;
                end else if (res_valid_reg & res_ready) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    res_valid_reg <= res_valid_reg;
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
